description.en: Open the Explorer at Testudines to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开龟鳖类，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Testudines time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的龟鳖类时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

title.zh: 龟鳖与鳞龙多样性样本

description.en: Open a source-bounded Turtles and lepidosaurs interval in the diversity view to inspect bundled sample counts, not an estimate of total richness.
description.zh: 在多样性视图中打开有来源边界的龟鳖与鳞龙区间，检查包内样本计数，而不是总体丰富度估计。

limitations: Counts are derived from the bundled, bounded occurrence sample and do not estimate total diversity, preservation-corrected richness, or a complete taxon range.

description.en: Open the approximately 220 Ma lower Xiaowa Formation window near Guanling, Guizhou, for Odontochelys specimens IVPP V 15639, V 13240 and V 15653. The rounded 220 Ma focus displays the sampled plastron and incomplete dorsal-shell context; plastron-first assembly remains a comparative homology model, not a direct ancestor sequence.
description.zh: 打开贵州关岭附近小洼组下部约 220 Ma 窗口，检查 Odontochelys 标本 IVPP V 15639、V 13240 和 V 15653。220 Ma 取整年龄用于显示取样到的腹甲与不完整背甲背景；腹甲先形成仍是比较同源性模型，不是直接祖先序列。

limitations: The 220 Ma point follows the available Testudines display envelope and the named Late Triassic sample; it is not a global FAD, LAD or complete turtle distribution.

The specimens, Xiaowa locality and shell reconstruction retain source, sampling and preservation boundaries; map context does not establish direct ancestry, causal mechanism or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

title.zh: Caribemys 冠群龟校准地图窗口

description.en: Open the approximately 155.6 Ma Oxfordian calibration window for Caribemys holotype MNHNCu P-3209 from western Cuba. The rounded focus represents the fossil's hard minimum in the cited clock model, not a direct crown-origin date, specimen-level radiometric date or global turtle FAD.
description.zh: 打开古巴西部 Caribemys 正模标本 MNHNCu P-3209 约 155.6 Ma 的牛津期校准窗口。该取整焦点表示所引分子钟模型中的化石硬下限，不是冠群起源的直接年龄、标本直接测年或全球龟类首现。

limitations: The 155.6 Ma point lies within the available Testudines envelope but is a hard-minimum calibration boundary for MNHNCu P-3209, not a complete occurrence interval or global FAD/LAD.
Topology, molecular data, priors and clock model affect the older posterior; the map route does not establish direct ancestry or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

title.zh: Taytalura 伊斯奇瓜拉斯托地图窗口

description.en: Open the approximately 231.4 Ma Late Carnian window for Taytalura holotype PVSJ 698 from the lower Cancha de Bochas Member of the Ischigualasto Formation, Argentina. The rounded focus is a stratigraphic navigation anchor for the three-dimensionally preserved skull and CT analysis, not a direct ancestor or global lepidosaur FAD.
description.zh: 打开阿根廷伊斯奇瓜拉斯托组 Cancha de Bochas 段下部 Taytalura 正模标本 PVSJ 698 的晚卡尼期约 231.4 Ma 窗口。该取整焦点是三维保存头骨及 CT 分析的地层导航锚点，不是直接祖先或全球鳞龙类首现。

limitations: The 231.7–231.1 Ma window is a rounded local stratigraphic envelope within the available Lepidosauria route; it is not a global FAD, LAD or complete distribution.
Only the PVSJ 698 skull is documented; stem placement and any ancestral-state reconstruction remain model- and matrix-dependent, and the map does not establish exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

title.zh: Megachirella 意大利阿尔卑斯地图窗口

description.en: Open the approximately 240 Ma Middle Triassic window for the only known Megachirella specimen, PZO 628, from the Italian Alps. The rounded age marks the fossil's study envelope while high-resolution micro-CT anatomy enters a combined morphology–molecule model; it is not a crown-Squamata FAD or direct ancestor observation.
description.zh: 打开意大利阿尔卑斯约 240 Ma 中三叠世窗口，检查目前唯一已知的 Megachirella 标本 PZO 628。取整年龄标记该化石的研究包络，高分辨率微 CT 解剖进入形态—分子联合模型；这不是冠群有鳞类首现或直接祖先观察。

limitations: The 240 Ma point follows the available Lepidosauria envelope and the rounded Middle Triassic PZO 628 horizon; it is not a global FAD, LAD or continuous lineage duration.
Compression, single-specimen sampling, character scoring, molecular partitions and clock priors bound the model; map context does not establish direct ancestry or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

title.zh: Bellairsia 基尔马卢格组地图窗口

description.en: Open the approximately 167 Ma Middle Jurassic Kilmaluag Formation window on Skye, Scotland, for near-complete Bellairsia gracilis specimen NMS G.2022.1.1. The rounded age summarizes the Bathonian horizon; synchrotron anatomy and stem-squamate placement are study-bounded evidence, while Kirtlington comparison material remains separate.
description.zh: 打开苏格兰斯凯岛中侏罗世基尔马卢格组约 167 Ma 窗口，检查近完整的 Bellairsia gracilis 标本 NMS G.2022.1.1。取整年龄概括巴通期层位；同步辐射解剖与有鳞类干群位置仅限本研究，基尔特灵比较材料保持分开。

limitations: The 168.3–166.1 Ma Bathonian window follows the available Lepidosauria envelope and the named Skye horizon; it is not a global FAD, LAD or complete squamate distribution.

NMS G.2022.1.1 is distinct from referred Kirtlington fragments; reconstruction, character coding and molecular-backbone constraints limit the model, and map context does not establish direct ancestry or exact co-registration.

title.zh: Mosasauroidea Dallasaurus 支系边界地图窗口

description.en: Open the 93.9–89.8 Ma middle Turonian Arcadia Park Shale window in north-central Texas for the Dallasaurus turneri skeleton sample. The 91.85 Ma focus is a rounded midpoint for comparing branch- and node-defined clades and plesiopedal anatomy; it is not a global mosasauroid FAD, LAD or ancestry sequence.
description.zh: 打开美国得州中北部中土仑期 Arcadia Park 页岩 93.9–89.8 Ma 窗口，检查 Dallasaurus turneri 骨架样本。91.85 Ma 是用于比较分支定义与节点定义支系及原始足型解剖的取整中点，不是全球沧龙超科首现、末现或祖先序列。

limitations: The 93.9–89.8 Ma interval follows the available Dallasaurus Mosasauroidea study envelope; it does not establish a global clade duration, complete distribution or FAD/LAD.

Clade definitions are explicit but basal branching remains analysis-sensitive; sampled plesiopedal anatomy and map markers do not establish direct ancestry, causal mechanism or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.
